Select distinct molecule_chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, and first_approval. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno as an inner join to enforce at least one compound record. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include canonical_smiles without dropping molecules that lack stored structures. Filter rows where max_phase is 3 or 4. Sort by molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, max_phase, and first_approval.
